title: BTS Open ARIRANG World Tour Chile Run at Estadio Nacional, Santiago
detail: BTS opened their first Chile concerts since 2017 at Santiago's Estadio Nacional with a 360-degree stage after a pre-show dispute over the ~600-ton setup was resolved with grass-protection plans. BioBioChile reported roughly 69,000 attendees (StarNews also cites ~60,000). Jimin, who turned 31 on Oct 13, got a surprise birthday moment; the crowd closed with a 'Sí se pudo' chant.
